bookmarks.title: Puddle Planet Setting Slip
bookmarks.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free printable bookmark writing prompt for building one tiny story place with paper, pencil, sketching, and imagination.
bookmarks.adultSetup: Print one bookmark, set out a pencil, and ask the kid to sketch the puddle post office before writing. Keep every message pretend and every choice story-only.
bookmarks.kidDirection: Imagine a small post office on Puddle Planet. Choose where it sits, what it looks like, and what tiny place detail changes the story.
bookmarks.bookmarkFrontPrompt: Bookmark front: The Puddle Planet post office sits beside ____________________.
bookmarks.bookmarkBackPrompt: Bookmark back: Add one setting clue from the puddle path: ____________________.
bookmarks.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A pretend letter floats past ____________________ and makes the whole place feel different.
bookmarks.firstLinePath: First line path: The puddle post office opened when ____________________.
bookmarks.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one plain place word with a clearer setting word: ____________________.
bookmarks.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch one puddle shape, then label it here: ____________________.
bookmarks.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At home, add one new setting detail near the post office: ____________________.

bookmarks.title: Buttonwood Train Character Ticket
bookmarks.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free printable bookmark writing prompt for inventing one helpful story character with paper, pencil, and a tiny train-ticket sketch.
bookmarks.adultSetup: Print one bookmark and invite a quick character ticket-mark sketch first. Ask for a pretend job, one habit, and one small choice the character can make.
bookmarks.kidDirection: Imagine a quiet helper riding the Buttonwood Library Train. Give the helper a job, a habit, and a reason to notice a book cart mix-up.
bookmarks.bookmarkFrontPrompt: Bookmark front: My Buttonwood Library Train helper is named ____________________.
bookmarks.bookmarkBackPrompt: Bookmark back: The helper's careful habit is ____________________.
bookmarks.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The train slows near ____________________, and the helper notices a story problem.
bookmarks.firstLinePath: First line path: On the library train, ____________________ always checked the tiny ticket shelf.
bookmarks.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one exact character action readers can picture: ____________________.
bookmarks.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the helper's ticket mark, then write one character word: ____________________.
bookmarks.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At home, give the helper one new library-train job: ____________________.

bookmarks.title: Teacup Weather Sensory Strip
bookmarks.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free printable bookmark writing prompt for adding color, sound, and texture details to a pretend weather-window scene.
bookmarks.adultSetup: Print one bookmark and place it near a table or window view. Ask for one color, one soft sound, and one pretend texture before the first sentence.
bookmarks.kidDirection: Imagine Teacup Town watches the weather window for story clues. Choose details a reader could see, hear, or imagine touching.
bookmarks.bookmarkFrontPrompt: Bookmark front: The weather window glows the color of ____________________.
bookmarks.bookmarkBackPrompt: Bookmark back: The tiny weather sound is ____________________.
bookmarks.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: When the window showed ____________________, Teacup Town knew a small plan had to change.
bookmarks.firstLinePath: First line path: The teacup window clicked softly as ____________________.
bookmarks.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one sensory word that makes the weather clue clearer: ____________________.
bookmarks.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw one tiny weather mark and label its feeling: ____________________.
bookmarks.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At home, add a new color, sound, or texture to ____________________.

bookmarks.title: Pocket Park Object Marker
bookmarks.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free printable bookmark writing prompt for giving one small story object a clear job in Pocket Park.
bookmarks.adultSetup: Print one bookmark and ask the kid to draw one object that could fit on a notice board. Then ask how that object helps the story move.
bookmarks.kidDirection: Imagine a tiny object pinned near the Pocket Park notice board. Decide what it is, where it came from, and what job it has in the scene.
bookmarks.bookmarkFrontPrompt: Bookmark front: The object pinned to the Pocket Park board is ____________________.
bookmarks.bookmarkBackPrompt: Bookmark back: This object helps the story because ____________________.
bookmarks.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A park helper finds ____________________ beside the notice board and follows its clue.
bookmarks.firstLinePath: First line path: Under the Pocket Park sign, ____________________ waited for someone to notice.
bookmarks.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one vague object word with an exact noun: ____________________.
bookmarks.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the object silently, then write its tiny job: ____________________.
bookmarks.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At home, add a second board object called ____________________.

bookmarks.title: Acorn Errand Sequence Tab
bookmarks.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free printable bookmark writing prompt for arranging a beginning, middle, and ending in an Acorn Avenue errand story.
bookmarks.adultSetup: Print one bookmark and draw three small boxes on scrap paper if helpful. Ask the kid to choose the first errand clue, the turn, and the ending choice.
bookmarks.kidDirection: Imagine the Acorn Avenue errand office has three pretend notes to sort. Put them in an order that makes the story easy to follow.
bookmarks.bookmarkBackPrompt: Bookmark back: Middle turn: ____________________. Ending choice: ____________________.
bookmarks.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The acorn clerk begins with ____________________, but the next note changes the route.
bookmarks.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one reason the middle event belongs after the first: ____________________.
bookmarks.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number three tiny boxes and fill only box one: ____________________.
bookmarks.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At home, retell the errand with a new final stop: ____________________.

bookmarks.title: Penny Path Revision Ribbon
bookmarks.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free printable bookmark writing prompt for improving one compass-shop sentence with paper, pencil, and a clearer detail.
bookmarks.adultSetup: Print one bookmark and ask for one short draft sentence first. Then invite the kid to choose a stronger direction word, object word, or setting detail.
bookmarks.kidDirection: Imagine the Penny Path compass shop has a sentence that almost works. Keep the main idea and make one part clearer.
bookmarks.bookmarkFrontPrompt: Bookmark front: My draft sentence says ____________________.
bookmarks.bookmarkBackPrompt: Bookmark back: The clearer detail I can add is ____________________.
bookmarks.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The compass keeper points toward ____________________, and one sentence needs a sharper clue.
bookmarks.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Circle one word to keep, then replace one dull word with ____________________.
bookmarks.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Rewrite only one word from the draft here: ____________________.
bookmarks.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At home, revise one compass-shop sentence about ____________________.
